test_title: PYST 3: SSC CPO - Reasoning (Held on: 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6 . Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '5'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1cbc758ac90bd22d5122cd51f49594b52dc86874b7bb4ce7e178553db8c6c123.png]
solution:
When we compare both the figures we get:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0acc8e64112cd7061d489ee1183b7fab9058b8231e533e696db631cf3db3513a.png] 

We observe that, when we move the dice left and downwards such that 1 and 3 are visible we find that on the top we have 5 and on the right we have 2 which means they both are opposite to each other. So 2 is the number on the face opposite the face showing 5.

Hence the correct answer is option 4).
